_help: Announcements shown in WeCalendar's notification bell. Add an item to the top of the list; give it a new unique id. Optional fields: tile (brand/tile-<name>.png: calendar, chart, checklist, cursor, hourglass, lightbulb, paper-plane, people, sealed-envelope, trophy), action {label, url}, audience ('all', or a list of emails / '@domain'), until (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.title: Reconnect your calendar
items.body: WeCalendar lost access to your Outlook calendar, so clients can't book your links right now. Reconnect it — it takes a few seconds and your existing links start working again.

items.title: WeCalendar has a new look
items.body: WeCalendar and your booking pages now use the new WeTransact brand, with Octavia along for the ride.
